summary: Enhance your skills with our Community-Based Risk Assessment Training. Discover essential tools and strategies for effective risk management in your community.
lede: Community-based risk assessment helps practitioners identify and prioritize risks with communities before planning programs. Designed for development, resilience, humanitarian, and planning professionals, the course covers participatory hazard profiling and mapping, vulnerability and capacity assessment, combining local knowledge with data, and turning ranked findings into practical risk-reduction actions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who regularly need to assess and prioritize risks with communities.
audience: Field coordinators and community development officers
Climate change adaptation and resilience practitioners
Social protection and safety net program designers
modules: Tools for Hazard Identification and Profiling
Participatory Mapping and Community Profiling Tools
Risk Scoring, Ranking, and Prioritization Tools
Data Collection and Analysis for Community Risk Assessment
Using GIS and Simple Technology for Risk Mapping (Introductory Level)
Integrating Climate, Conflict, and Emerging Risks
From Assessment to Community Risk Reduction Planning
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of community development and risk management principles. Familiarity with community engagement and participatory methods is advantageous.
